accepted: Seven passing cable examples do not prove universal vacuity.
Ribbon patterns preserve ribbonness: independently checked Eisermann Proposition 6.13 and Corollary 6.15.
A three-parallel can be tested using truncated exact Jones coefficients rather than a full polynomial.
rejected_or_unverified: Proposed HKL(2,13) experiment was already completed, in both advanced and direct modes. Stored results are null, not a new computation.
Null HKL output does not establish matching twisted polynomials or positive evidence of smooth concordance.
The suggested equivalence between non-concordance-invariance and usefulness on a fixed slice satellite is not established; the converse is insufficient.
The proposed Bing-double Sato-Levine/Arf identity is unverified and is not used.
The finite census correlation proposal is a hypothesis, not a proof that all slice links pass or that a particular GST link can fail.
